NFI.questionable_assumption_or_gap: Dry constant-g geopotential formula; geometric height substituted.

NFI.how_it_affects_margin_or_SF: Density moves float margin. Pressure moves every SF inversely.
E scales collapse linearly in all three models. Density scales metallic mass.

NFI.questionable_assumption_or_gap: 0.2 is a cited severe typical knockdown, not a curve at R/t.
NFI.direction_of_further_investigation: Evaluate NASA SP-8032 at this complete-sphere geometry.
NFI.how_it_affects_margin_or_SF: SF scales directly with the knockdown. It does not change mass.

NFI.questionable_assumption_or_gap: Collapse formula extrapolates the monocoque D-S identity. Shear, wrinkling and core crush are omitted.
NFI.direction_of_further_investigation: Replace with a published sandwich-sphere formula that includes core shear.
NFI.how_it_affects_margin_or_SF: Shear would lower collapse pressure. The omission is optimistic for SF.

NFI.direction_of_further_investigation: Pin a honeycomb or foam sheet at the thickness used.
NFI.how_it_affects_margin_or_SF: Core density scales core mass and can erase the float margin. It does not enter the reported collapse formula.

NFI.questionable_assumption_or_gap: Tributary width equals spacing, members are pinned, mesh is a real-valued equal triangulation, tube crippling ignored.
NFI.direction_of_further_investigation: Integer geodesic, end fixity, imperfection knockdown and local crippling.
NFI.how_it_affects_margin_or_SF: Euler pressure scales with I and E and inversely with s^3. Mass scales with edge count and area.
